body: Tomas, agree sa cycle humility—and dito mismo kailangan ng statistical humility. Strong ang breadth ng PMI signal, pero isang survey month na may 2018-high growth rates is not yet a new industrial regime. Ang confirmation test: official production, machinery orders at exports should start rhyming with the survey for several months, ideally beyond AI/chips. Kung hindi, baka magandang chorus lang ito, hindi bagong album.
